state.task: Polish the entire existing Daily Consensus public research UI without changing market data, history, product scope, claims or source rights.

brand.tone: restrained editorial financial research; no gradients, promotional badges or AI dashboard decoration

componentCatalog: Brand: four vertical sage strokes and two-line wordmark
MorningLayout header: brand + Morning view/Research desk/Archive links + theme toggle
ResearchDesk:216px navigation sidebar, topbar, main content and optional context rail
MorningBoard: equal-family verdict, coverage, dated chart panels, source drawer, three tabs, instrument/horizon/history controls
Archive index/article: older inconsistent DC square brand and no theme toggle
Methodology: no shared header, long two-column prose panels
TradingViewWidget: opaque hosted frame, parent loading/error status, source attribution; load event cannot prove child content rendered
observedCodeIssues: Utility tokens currently10/11/12px; many morning captions9px; compressed mobile table labels
Archive and article brand/navigation inconsistent with home and research desk; methodology lacks shared header
Essential research nav/link/disclosure targets sometimes under44px
Light muted text contrast4.18-4.33 on raised/hover backgrounds
A real prior production screenshot showed an empty hosted chart after load; parent cannot inspect cross-origin frame
constraints: Keep existing component stack and local fonts
Never hide dates, sample limitations or missing-state meaning
No fake charts or readings to fill empty spaces
No provider iframe extraction or sandbox relaxation
No persistent security or account settings
Codex independently implements selected decisions; all combinations validated and rendered checks required
state.reviewEvidence: Fresh comprehensive browser audit is executing; these independent design decisions concern confirmed component/code structure. No claim that code alone proves visual quality.

reading_scale.instructions: Choose the shared reading scale for this dense research product. Preserve scanability and real source detail while making mobile text readable. Explicit essential44px targets are mandatory for every choice.

criteria.balanced_editorial: Use14px body,12px secondary and11px compact metadata; use16px long prose and mobile text inputs; raise legacy9px captions to11px where practical and keep charts dense through responsive layout.
criteria.large_everywhere: Use16px for all body,labels,source notes and tables, leaving only headings larger; accept substantially longer pages.
criteria.minimal_scale: Keep12px body and10px metadata; adjust spacing and colors only.

publication_navigation.instructions: Choose a coherent navigation/brand structure for morning, archive, article and methodology surfaces while retaining the research desk sidebar.

criteria.shared_editorial_header: Reuse one Brand+primary navigation+theme header across morning/archive/article/methodology; mark active section, wrap nav to a second row on narrow phones; research desk keeps its purposeful sidebar.
criteria.separate_polished_headers: Keep four existing header structures but align typography and enlarge links; add separate theme toggles.
criteria.sidebar_everywhere: Convert all content pages to the research desk sidebar layout, including long archive articles.

methodology_layout.instructions: Select how to present the existing detailed methodology document without hiding required facts or rewriting them.

criteria.reading_sections: Readable content column with16px prose, clear section rhythm and a compact in-page contents list that wraps on mobile; source definitions can stay structured.
criteria.dense_cards: Keep all equally weighted two-column prose cards and raise only font size.
criteria.collapsed_all: Collapse every methodology section behind an accordion by default.

hosted_view_recovery.instructions: An opaque provider iframe sometimes loads blank while its load event fires. Without inspecting or modifying provider data, choose always-available recovery controls that avoid pretending we know whether the chart is visible.

criteria.inline_recovery: Below the existing chart, retain attribution and add unobtrusive Reload view and Open provider controls plus explicit third-party scope. Keep actual timeout/error state and avoid inferring success from visible child content.
criteria.persistent_overlay: Keep a large troubleshooting overlay on top of the chart until the reader confirms it loaded.
criteria.external_only: Remove embedded provider charts and replace all with outbound links.

research_density.instructions: Choose the Research Desk polish direction given existing sidebar/main/rail layout, small source labels and long reports.

criteria.refine_existing_shell: Keep the shell, improve text scale and44px controls, consistent panel padding, responsive rail stacking, section title spacing and clear reading width.
criteria.single_column_everywhere: Remove the context rail and sidebar for all users and display every view as one long column.
criteria.add_dashboard_summary: Add new summary metrics, recommendation tiles and decorative charts above each report.
